1. **`lineVAT(line)`** — Calculates VAT per line:

   - Rounded using `roundCents()` to handle fractional cents

   - `discount`: sum of all line discounts

- Line VATs rounded individually, then summed (never rounded at invoice level)
- All amounts clamped at 0 (can never go negative)
- Render shows optional lines (only if > 0) for subtotal, discount, VAT
